verdict.rationale: Paystack is a payments SaaS with a data dashboard, so in-product AI insights is a fair axis, but the evidence contains no AI-generated insights or suggestions. The dashboard offers purchase-pattern analytics and exports, and automated payment routing and fraud systems exist, but these are adjacent non-AI features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
